question: The Cotton Corporation of India (CCI) was established in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1970**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Cotton Corporation of India (CCI)** was **established** on **31st July 1970** as a **Government Company registered under the Companies Act 1956.**
 
• In the** initial period of setting up**, as an **agency in the Public Sector,** a **Corporation **was charged with the responsibility of **equitable distribution of cotton **among the **different constituents **of the industry and to **serve as a vehicle **for the **canalization** of** imports of cotton.**
 
• At present, **CCI **is operating in all the **cotton-growing states **with **more **than **400 procurement centers **and **19 Branch Offices.​****​**
